name: com.enioka.scanner.sdk.athesi.RD50TE.AthesiE5LProvider
description: When Enioka Scan searches for a built-in scanner on an Athesi RD50TE/E5L handheld, this service makes that device's barcode reader available to the app.
disableEffect: Barcode scanning through the built-in reader on an Athesi RD50TE/E5L device stops working.
